name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm for as long as you choose, then compacts or hands off before it expires; holds a costly cold send with its price and your choices; /keepwarm opens a pane with the session's settings

keepWarm.title: Cache keeper: keep the cache warm while you're away
keepWarm.description: Shortly before the cache would expire, ask Claude a one-word side question over the conversation. It reads the cache (a twentieth to a tenth of the input price) and restarts its timer, so the next message doesn't re-write the whole conversation.

keepWarmHours.title: Cache keeper: keep it warm for (hours after your last message)
keepWarmHours.description: Keep-warms stop once this long has passed since Claude last answered you. Then the action below runs before the cache expires.

atExpiry.title: Cache keeper: before the cache finally expires
atExpiry.description: nothing: let it expire. compact: compact the conversation while the cache is still warm, so the next message re-caches only the summary. handoff: Claude writes a handoff, the conversation is cleared, and the handoff is kept for the next message.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache keeper: cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the cache lives after its last use: 60 on Claude subscriptions, 5 for most API-key sessions.

leadMinutes.title: Cache keeper: act this many minutes before expiry
leadMinutes.description: How early to send the keep-warm, compact or handoff. At most half the cache lifetime.

coldGuard.title: Cache keeper: before a costly cold send
coldGuard.description: When the cache has expired and the conversation is large, the next message re-writes all of it at the cache-write price. refuse: hold that message above the prompt with its price, to send anyway, compact first, clear, or discard; sending it again goes through. warn: show the price and send. off: say nothing.

guardMinTokens.title: Cache keeper: guard conversations of at least (tokens)
guardMinTokens.description: Smaller conversations are cheap to re-write and pass without a word.

showRow.title: Cache keeper: show the cache row above the prompt
showRow.description: One row: warm or cold, time left, keep-warms and what they cost. Off, the status line shows a short version instead.
